proposals.title: PROPOSAL 5 - REGARDING ANNUAL REPORTS REGARDING THE PREVENTION OF HARASSMENT AND DISCRIMINATION IN THE WORKPLACE
proposals.proponent: State of New York Office of the State Comptroller (NYS Comptroller)
proposals.topic_summary: Requests the board oversee an annual public report quantifying the effectiveness and outcomes of company efforts to prevent workplace sexual harassment and discrimination against protected classes of employees.
proposals.evidence: our board unanimously recommends that you vote "AGAINST" this shareholder proposal.
